overview.description: The Northern Trust Emerging Markets Quality Low Volatility ETF (QLVE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of large- and mid-cap equities from emerging markets. Holdings are selected for quality and low volatility. QLVE was launched on Jul 15, 2019 and is issued by Northern Trust.
